title: Immune-Metabolic Profiling Reveals Functional Heterogeneity Within Colorectal Cancer Consensus Molecular Subtypes.

title: NGS-Based Genomic Profiling Identifies Independent Predictors of Time to Castration Resistance in Hormone-Sensitive Prostate Cancer: A Retrospective Real-World Study.
snippet: The prognostic significance of next-generation sequencing (NGS) findings during the hormone-sensitive phase of prostate cancer remains incompletely characterized. This retrospective cohort study included 92 patients who underwent NGS analysis on tumor tissue between 2019 and 2025. The primary endpoint was time to castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC)....
